attributes.name: The Sandpoint Devil
attributes.powers:
After the encounter, banish the Sandpoint Devil.

"After what we heard up on the roof—the clomping and snorting and that terrible, terrible tearing—I ain't ashamed to say I kept right there between the sheets and didn't even think about coming out till morning. We lost three cows and my favorite porker that night.

"I still feel like we got off easy."—Account of Missy Rundell, Sandpoint farmer
